integrity: Complete self-contained proof; numerical checker provides finite implementation corroboration only. No infinite theorem inferred from finite testing. Previously available claims consulted only for mathematical overlap.
scientific_limitations: Exact class-wide constant at fixed graph diameter, not an exact heat-norm time profile for a given graph. Assumes finite simple unweighted combinatorial graphs and unnormalized Laplacians. Fixes diameter before branching tends to infinity. Does not classify all near-extremizers.
title: Diameter-sharp transient Lipschitz amplification by graph heat on finite trees
